=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:252-281, 305-325, 418 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `followup-guard` check runs only once, before the required-checks wait (up to AUTO_MERGE_CHECKS_WAIT_MINUTES, default 45), and is not run again before auto-merge is enabled at line 418; the post-wait recheck at 315-325 covers base freshness only, and `--match-head-commit` binds the follow-up's own head, not the base.
  WHY: The parent's audit can post `status=clean` during the wait, so the stale `allow` lets the follow-up merge into the clean-audited head and move it (the #9479/#9356 shape); severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT (secondary, because report-side retirement covers the common case) and the other four rated it MAJOR, so the highest (MAJOR) is used.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1431-1471 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The deterministic-skip-merge job's squash branch (`elif gh_retry gh pr merge "${PR_NUMBER}" --repo "${REPOSITORY}" --squash --auto --match-head-commit "${PR_HEAD_SHA}"; then`, lines 1446-1468) and its forward-merge branch (line 1431) enable auto-merge without calling the new `followup-guard`.
  WHY: Small security follow-up PRs take the `small_diff` route (scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:1241-1243) straight to this unguarded branch and auto-merge into the clean-audited parent head, which is the exact #9479 / PR #9356 failure; the only cover is report-side retirement, which fails open.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2570-2572, 2663-2665, 3223-3224 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The review-blocked judge's `merge)` branches and the `merge_with_followup` synchronous merge post the success head-gate status and run `gh pr merge` with no parent-head clean-marker check or `followup-guard` call.
  WHY: single_pass_gate skips PRs whose base is not the default branch (review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:476-483, reason=not_standalone), so a follow-up that reaches the judge and gets `merge`/`merge_with_followup` is merged into the clean-audited head, which moves the head and restarts the #9479 loop.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:829-957 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: single_pass_followup_merge_guard has no `SINGLE_ISSUE_SECURITY_PASS_ENABLED` check (unlike single_pass_gate at lines 458-463), and the "Enable auto-merge on PR" step env (review_autofix.yml:4418-4432) does not pass that variable, so the guard runs and can return `unverifiable` even when the feature is disabled.
  WHY: In repos with the security pass off (default 'false', review_autofix.yml:4387), a transient pulls, /user or comments API failure now blocks auto-merge for stacked PRs that merged before this change, because review_enable_auto_merge.sh:273-277 refuses on `unverifiable`.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:868-877 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The guard's head-filtered listing `gh api "repos/${REPOSITORY}/pulls?state=open&head=${guard_owner}:${guard_ref_uri}&per_page=100"` pins `guard_owner="${REPOSITORY%%/*}"`, so a parent PR from a fork or another owner returns zero matches, `guard_parent` becomes `{}`, and the guard emits `allow no_standalone_parent`.
  WHY: Reviewers say a clean-audited cross-owner or fork parent slips through and the merge proceeds; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly rejected this claim (a fork branch cannot be a same-repo PR's base, and single_pass_gate at 476-483 skips non-same-repo heads, so such a parent never carries a clean marker).
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:353-355 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The retirement listing `gh api --paginate --slurp "repos/${REPOSITORY}/pulls?state=open&base=${retire_ref_uri}&per_page=100"` together with the jq `head.repo.full_name != REPOSITORY` filter never lists fork-headed or other-repo follow-up PRs, so they are never closed.
  WHY: Unretired fork-based follow-ups stay open and can be merged by another path, moving the audited clean head; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly rejected this claim (the exclusion is deliberate, because pipeline follow-ups are opened in REPOSITORY by construction).
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:351-439 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: single_pass_retire_followups is neither atomic nor idempotent: the per-item comment-then-close loops (380-419) post `${retire_marker}` with no pre-check for an existing `<!-- ai:single-issue-security-pass-followup-retired:v1 head=<sha> -->` marker, and a close failure after a successful comment leaves the item open.
  WHY: A mid-loop or transient PATCH failure leaves some items retired and others open, with the marker comment claiming retirement and no re-trigger path; re-runs can duplicate API calls and comments. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly rejected this claim (the fail-open, logged design is what the issue asks for, `state=open` listings skip closed items, and the merge-side guard covers partial close failures).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Defence in depth on the merge side: the review merge path must not merge a PR whose base is a standalone PR's head branch when that branch's current head has a status=clean security-pass marker. Instead it logs, comments once, and leaves the PR open."
  expected_change_site: The deterministic-skip-merge job in .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml (lines 1371-1476; forward-merge branch at line 1431, squash branch at line 1468; possibly via the existing sourced scripts/review_autofix_step_deterministic_skip_security_pass.sh per §24) and the judge merge sites in scripts/review_rb_judge.sh (merge helper at 2467-2469, 2570-2572, 2663-2665, merge_with_followup sync merge at 3223-3225), in addition to scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The only `followup-guard` call is in scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh (lines 262-277), no diff hunk touches the deterministic-skip merge in review_autofix.yml or the judge merge paths in review_rb_judge.sh, `pr_changed_files` contains neither file, grep finds zero `followup-guard` references in either file while they merge at review_autofix.yml:1431/1468 and review_rb_judge.sh:2467-2469/2571-2572/2664-2665/3224, the only test (test_auto_merge_helper_runs_followup_guard_before_merge) inspects only review_enable_auto_merge.sh, and the plan grant's `files_touched` lists only scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh, so the fix needs a scope extension or a documented decision to exclude the other paths (google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite rated this BLOCKER; the others rated it MAJOR)
- requirement: "a listing failure still posts the clean marker and re-dispatches the review" (spec item 3) and "Fail open: a listing or close failure logs a warning ... never changes the clean outcome or blocks the review re-dispatch"
  expected_change_site: tests/test_single_issue_security_pass.py
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: The reviewer reports this as already covered, not a gap: the PR adds test_clean_report_followup_listing_failure_still_posts_marker_and_redispatches and test_clean_report_close_failures_fail_open, and the changelog.d and agents.d fragments are present (SEVERITY: NIT)
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
